svg.aria-label: Dependency graph of fault_rescue: page fault, LZ4 HW fails, the kernel decodes the page itself
svg.text: fault_rescue: page fault, LZ4 HW fails, the kernel decodes the page itself
25 steps. One after the other: 6349 ns. Longest path through the graph: 6149 ns. Assumed step costs, not measurements.

path.title: mark_decompressing before submit: page marked before the lock is dropped for the job
cpl_read before cache_invalidate: the kernel learns from the completion that the HW has stopped writing
cache_invalidate before frame_write: old lines dropped before the CPU writes the frame itself
sw_decode before set_present: PRESENT only after the page is back
frame_write before sw_clean: what the CPU wrote must reach DRAM
sw_clean before pte_map: frame content before the PTE is valid
set_present before wake_page: waiters wake up to read the new state
note_fresh before eret: page protected before the thread leaves the kernel
access before exception: the CPU MMU finds the PTE not valid
exception before check_state: the kernel runs once the CPU has taken the exception
sw_decode before cot_clear: the stored copy is needed until the page is back in the frame
cot_clear before release_chunks: entry first, so it never points at free chunks

svg.text: every step of section B is done
needs what the step above produced
longest path: it sets the time; steps on it have a thick border
Number in a step: assumed cost. "? ns": cost not in the model. No number: a few instructions, not costed.
